step1.title: Deterministic Math First, LLM Second
step1.body: Every critical ratio—Risk/Reward, BEP, cash runway, and Debt Service Ratio—is computed first by pure TypeScript engines in under a millisecond. The LLM is strictly forbidden from inventing figures outside those locked outputs.

step2.title: Autonomous Daily Macro Radar
step2.body: Our zero-dependency pipeline harvests USD/IDR, IHSG, Gold, and Bitcoin every morning into an isolated data branch. When the market regime shifts to RISK_OFF or CAUTIOUS, committee scrutiny tightens automatically.

step3.title: Optimistic Assumptions vs. Failure Reality
step3.body: Instead of validating your thesis, our Risk Division assumes your plan has already collapsed six months from today—then works backward to expose the 3 deadliest blind spots hiding in your numbers.
step3.left_text: Unit margin looks healthy at IDR 65k and payback feels achievable within a few busy months.
step3.right_text: Target of 210 units sits below the 224-unit BEP. A 40% slow-season dip burns through IDR 30M before month four.

step4.title: Bias Mirror & Instant What-If Slider
step4.body: Compare your initial confidence against mathematical resilience via the Optimism Bias Mirror. Once the verdict lands, drag the What-If Stress Slider to locate your plan's exact breaking point in real time with zero API cost.

memo.p1: Most retail traders hit by margin calls, small businesses running dry in month three, and households trapped by installments do not fail from a lack of information. They fail because the human brain naturally hunts for confirmation of a decision it already wants to make.
memo.p2: Unfortunately, most modern AI assistants amplify that bias. Trained to be agreeable, they wrap fragile financial plans in polite encouragement instead of pointing straight at the structural leak in the math.
memo.p3: TesisLab is built on one uncompromising rule: deterministic mathematics holds supreme veto power, while AI exists solely to dissect worst-case failure scenarios before real capital leaves your account.
memo.p4: This tool is not a licensed financial advisor and never promises quick returns. It is a cold stress-testing chamber for anyone who would rather be rejected by a calculator today than absorb avoidable ruin six months from now.

evidence.title: Not Profit Promises, But Empirical Evidence.
evidence.subtitle: Instead of fabricated testimonials, every audit gate in TesisLab stands on peer-reviewed risk management and decision psychology research.

cards.author: Gary Klein
cards.summary: Pre-Mortem analysis significantly improves teams' ability to identify project failure paths compared to standard optimistic reviews.

cards.author: Kahneman & Tversky
cards.summary: Decision-makers systematically underestimate real costs and overestimate expected payoffs when evaluating risky plans.

cards.author: Sharma et al.
cards.summary: Large language models tend to agree with flawed user beliefs, requiring a deterministic veto layer that separates math from prose.

cards.author: Drawdown Asymmetry
cards.summary: A 50% drawdown on trading capital requires a 100% gain just to break even; strict loss limits beat directional prediction.

cards.author: Startup Post-Mortems
cards.summary: 38% of new venture failures stem directly from running out of cash runway before reaching operational break-even.

cards.author: Debt Service Limit
cards.summary: Debt service ratios above 30%–35% of net monthly income sharply amplify default vulnerability under income shocks.

live_preview.title: REAL-TIME PRE-AUDIT TELEMETRY
live_preview.footer_hint: Recalculates live as you type. Run the Pre-Mortem Audit to convene the 3-division AI committee and lock the verdict.
live_preview.tip_be_wr: Minimum win-rate required simply to break even given your current Risk:Reward ratio.
live_preview.tip_safe_size: Maximum position size (% of capital) that keeps total loss per trade within the 2% risk cap.
live_preview.tip_sl_atr: Ratio of your Stop-Loss distance to the asset's 14-day ATR. Below 1.0× means your stop sits inside daily noise.
live_preview.tip_payback: Estimated months required for projected monthly profit to recover your initial capital.
live_preview.tip_mos: How far sales can drop (in %) before your business hits operational break-even (BEP).
live_preview.tip_savings: Percentage of net monthly income remaining after living expenses and the new installment.
live_preview.tip_mc: 1,000 randomized stress paths estimating ruin/deficit probability and P5 (worst) to P95 (best) ending outcomes.
live_preview.smart_rec_body: Current setup triggers risk warnings. Align SL to ≥ 1.5× ATR-14, target 1:2.0 R:R, and cap position size under the 2% risk rule.
